title: ElevenLabs TTS Multilingual v2
description: Generate multilingual text-to-speech audio using ElevenLabs TTS Multilingual v2.

inputs.name: text
inputs.tooltip: The text to convert to speech

inputs.name: voice
inputs.tooltip: The voice to use for speech generation Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.tooltip: Speech speed (0.7-1.2). Values below 1.0 slow down the speech, above 1.0 speed it up. Extreme values may affect quality.

inputs.name: timestamps
inputs.tooltip: Whether to return timestamps for each word in the generated speech

inputs.name: previous_text
inputs.tooltip: The text that came before the text of the current request. Can be used to improve the speech's continuity when concatenating together multiple generations or to influence the speech's continuity in the current generation. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: next_text
inputs.tooltip: The text that comes after the text of the current request. Can be used to improve the speech's continuity when concatenating together multiple generations or to influence the speech's continuity in the current generation. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: language_code
inputs.tooltip: Language code (ISO 639-1) used to enforce a language for the model. An error will be returned if language code is not supported by the model. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: apply_text_normalization
inputs.tooltip: This parameter controls text normalization with three modes: 'auto', 'on', and 'off'. When set to 'auto', the system will automatically decide whether to apply text normalization (e.g., spelling out numbers). With 'on', text normalization will always be applied, while with 'off', it will be skipped.
